statement: Fix α > 0, M = ⌊αN⌋, and f ∈ Cb(R). Suppose the law of AN is invariant under left and right orthogonal multiplication and, in probability, 1 rN rN ∑ r=1 δsN,r =⇒ ν, max r≤rN dist(sN,r, supp ν) −→ 0, (2.2) where ν is a deterministic compactly supported probability measure on [0, ∞). Then FN (AN , f) converges in probability and in mean to a deterministic value Fα,ν(f). 3 Here is its formula. Approximate the singular slots in operator norm by finitely many positive values s1, . . . , sh whose multiplicities satisfy nj/M → pj > 0. Thus ∑ j pj = min(1, 1/α). Put vj = αpj, and, if α < 1, add an input null block with v0 = 1 − α. Let I = {1, . . . , h} when α ≥ 1 and I = {0, 1, . . . , h} otherwise. The variable ρi is the fraction of the input squared norm assigned to block i. The value for this finite approximation is sup ρi>0 ∑ i∈I ρi=1 ⎧ ⎨ ⎩ 1 2 ∑ i∈I vi log ρi vi + αPf p ⎛ ⎝ ( s2 j ρj α )h j=1 ⎞ ⎠ ⎫ ⎬ ⎭ . (2.3) The limit of (2.3) as the spectral mesh tends to zero is Fα,ν(f). Blocks with zero limiting proportion are not used in (2.3); the no-outlier assumption ensures the required approximations with positive limiting proportions.
